turns.question: In what share of our customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 did the customer raise an objection?
turns.answer: About 33.3% of the labelled customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 had the customer raise an objection (objection rate: a model-derived share of labelled calls, calls with an objection over calls labelled, over those two days).
